definitions.explanation: The statistical likelihood of an event occurring, often expressed as a percentage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{降水|こうすい}→降水：09807_kousui⟧{確率|かくりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧60%⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：02638_seikou⟧{確率|かくりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: The probability of success is low.

examples.japanese: {確率|かくりつ}⟦{論|ろん}→論：04017_ron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I studied probability theory at university.

notes:
{確率|かくりつ} is used for mathematical or statistical probability.

Common collocations:
- ⟦{降水|こうすい}→降水：09807_kousui⟧{確率|かくりつ} (chance of precipitation)
- {確率|かくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (probability is high/low)
- {確率|かくりつ}⟦{論|ろん}→論：04017_ron⟧ (probability theory)
- ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧{確率|かくりつ} (winning probability)

Related terms:
- ⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧ (possibility - less mathematical)
- ⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧ (prospect, likelihood)
